content: R3F v9 (Feb 2025) pairs with React 19; v8 pairs with React 18. Tested Feb 2026: three@0.182.0, @react-three/fiber@9.5.0, @react-three/drei@10.7.7, @react-three/postprocessing@3+. No overhead over vanilla Three.js — components render outside React, outperforms Three.js at scale via React scheduling. v9 adds WebGPU support via async gl prop, improved Suspense/side-effect handling, dynamic JSX types. CanvasProps replaces Props. Use dynamic imports with ssr:false for Next.js to avoid hydration errors.
